Subject: Veridian Health — Security intake and SSO/SCIM evidence (post-demo follow-up)

Hi Angela / Veridian team,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — appreciate the time and thoughtful questions. Per our conversation, I wanted to capture the security and access items we discussed and outline the next steps so your procurement and security teams have a clear intake path.

Quick recap of asks you mentioned:
- SOC 2 status (Type II) and expected availability of the report
- GDPR / HIPAA posture and data residency options for PHI workflows
- SSO support (SAML / OIDC) and SCIM provisioning for directory sync
- RBAC / admin controls and audit logging details
- Completed vendor security questionnaire for procurement

What I’m attaching for your review:
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (high-level SOC 2 status & scope)
- redwood-sso-scim-guide.pdf (implementation notes for SSO + SCIM endpoints)

Next steps I propose:
1) Please return the vendor security questionnaire (attached) with any fields you prefer we complete on your behalf or return to procurement.
2) If SOC 2 Type II is not yet available, share the anticipated date and any interim evidence we can provide (system description, control matrix).
3) Confirm whether Veridian requires SCIM push provisioning or just SAML SSO plus manual account creation initially.
4) Share a contact for your security/compliance lead (email) so we can coordinate evidence delivery and an intake call if helpful.

I’ll loop in our security ops and PMs internally to prioritize evidence collection — Vanessa will own the evidence pack and Marissa will support technical follow-ups.

Timing: we can prepare a preliminary pack within 3 business days once we have a prioritized checklist from your side.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri y.om.das@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: Veridian Health — Security intake and SSO/SCIM evidence (post-demo follow-up)

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the clear recap — that aligns with what we need. A few quick notes from our side:
- SOC 2: We are currently evaluating vendors and require SOC 2 Type II for production data handling. We do not have a report from you yet; please indicate whether one will be available or if you can provide interim artifacts (system description, control narratives).
- GDPR/HIPAA: Veridian handles PHI in scoped workflows; we need confirmation of HIPAA BA readiness and details on data processing locations.
- SSO/SCIM: We prefer SCIM provisioning to avoid manual onboarding. Please confirm whether your SCIM implementation supports deprovisioning and which attributes are synced.

Attaching our standard procurement intake and a short questionnaire — please have it returned to procurement@veridianhealth.com.

Also, can you provide a short timeline (estimated days) for the evidence pack and whom at Redwood will be the single point of contact?

Best,
Angela Ross
Head of IT Security
Veridian Health
[Attachment: veridian_procurement_intake_v1.pdf (PDF)]
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Angela Ross <angela.ross@veridianhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@veridianhealth.com>

Date: Sat, 20 Jan 2028 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Veridian Health — Security intake and SSO/SCIM evidence (post-demo follow-up)

Hi Angela — thanks, and appreciate the procurement form.

Short answers / proposed timeline:
- SOC 2: Redwood holds SOC 2 Type II for our serving infrastructure (scope: inference runtime, control period through 2027-09). I’m attaching a summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) and we can provide the full report under NDA — if procurement needs the full report we can initiate that exchange. Estimated: 2–3 business days to prepare interim pack; 5–7 business days to coordinate NDA/report delivery.
- HIPAA: We support HIPAA-safe deployments via our Private offering and have BA templates. We support region-specific processing; we’re happy to map the Veridian PHI flow to our controls.
- SCIM: Our SCIM supports standard push provisioning (create/update/deactivate); deprovisioning is supported. We sync name, email, username, groups, title, and custom attributes on request. Technical guide attached (redwood-sso-scim-guide.pdf).

Action items (internal / owner):
- Vanessa: compile SOC 2 artifacts, system description, control matrix (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf + full report on NDA).
- Marissa: prepare SCIM endpoint test plan and sample mapping; provide expected attribute list and sample payloads.
- Priyom: consolidate returned questionnaire, coordinate with procurement, and confirm deal timeline.

I’ll also upload the completed questionnaire you sent to our shared Drive and will return a filled version to procurement after internal review.

Deal reference: RDW-VER-1432. HubSpot link: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/47821

Thanks — Vanessa and Marissa, can you confirm you’re able to start and an ETA (EOD Mon or Tue)?

Regards,
Priyom
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
